title: Маржа, наценка и маржинальность товара: расчёт на одном примере
decision: Create independently: one-product calculation of gross profit, margin and markup is distinct from marketplace economics and MySklad report selection.

demand.source: TrueTell_Wordstat_079_2026-10-22.xlsx, sheet Темы статей; SEO-071 row in current backlog
demand.caveat: These are request counts, not people or a traffic forecast. Broad and quoted counts are separate matching modes and are not additive. Wordstat warned some data might be temporarily unavailable.

intent.primary: Understand why margin percentage and markup percentage differ and calculate both on the same product.
intent.distinction: The existing marketplace-profit article covers commissions, returns and channel expenses; the MySklad reports article covers reports and cost-of-sales. SEO-071 focuses on definitions, denominators and discount impact for one illustrative product.
intent.product: No direct TrueTell product is relevant.

example.basis: Illustrative sale price/revenue 1,500 ₽ excluding VAT; cost of goods sold included in this simplified calculation 1,000 ₽; costs outside that basis are named.

sources.label: ФСБУ 4/2023, п. 27
sources.supports: Gross profit as revenue less cost of sales, distinct from later expenses.

sources.label: AQA accounting ratios
sources.supports: Gross profit margin uses revenue as denominator; markup uses cost of sales.

sources.label: OpenStax, Principles of Financial Accounting, Key Terms
sources.supports: Gross margin and the boundary between gross profit and operating expenses.

visuals.purpose: Compare the same 500 ₽ gross profit divided by revenue and cost of sales.
Show the illustrative effect of a 10% discount on revenue, gross profit and margin.

findings: No P1/P2 issues. Formula calculations, terminology, qualifications, intent, FAQ/schema, HTML metadata, images and internal links were checked.
The reviewer requested one P3 clarity improvement: explicitly label the formulas as gross profit; the SVG/PNG were updated and the reviewer confirmed final labels fit and remain readable.
Reviewer independently checked the accounting and educational sources.
boundaries: Wordstat was not remeasured by the reviewer.
Main agent performed local browser inspection.
